title: Enumerating Homogeneous Square Subdomains
description: Given an m x n binary matrix consisting only of 0s and 1s, count the total number of square submatrices that are composed entirely of 1s.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers m and n representing the matrix dimensions.
The next m lines each contain n space-separated integers (0 or 1).
output_format: Print the total count of square submatrices containing only integers value 1.
constraints:
1 <= m, n <= 300
matrix[i][j] is either 0 or 1
